about.name: Anu Anand Annu
about.title: Software Engineer | Agentic AI & Full-Stack Developer
about.summary: Software Engineer with 2+ years building production Agentic AI systems at GEP Worldwide, processing thousands of global supplier records. Designed LangGraph multi-agent pipelines that cut onboarding from 12 days to 15 minutes and reduced manual effort by 90%. IIT Tirupati CS graduate with hands-on experience in RAG, Azure Document Intelligence, and LLM orchestration at enterprise scale. Seeking AI Engineer roles to architect intelligent automation systems at scale.

description: Architected an end-to-end supplier creation automation pipeline — spanning data auto-fill, multi-format document extraction, multilingual support, and real-time sanctions/adverse media screening — achieving 95% validation accuracy and eliminating 90% of manual effort across 5,000+ supplier records.

Architected a LangGraph multi-agent orchestration system with persistent memory, cross-agent context sharing, and real-time Brave Search API integration — compressing supplier onboarding from 12 days to 15 minutes (97% reduction) across 5,000+ global suppliers.

Designed and deployed an Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) Agent using Azure Document Intelligence — parsing PDFs, scanned images, and structured forms with 96% field-extraction accuracy, eliminating 95% of manual data-entry.
Built a Supplier Assistant RAG Agent combining retrieval-augmented guidance, real-time third-party API tools, and contextual supplier data — reducing support team dependency by ~60%.
Led a 4-engineer team — owning sprint planning, risk mitigation, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment — achieving 100% on-time delivery with zero production regressions.
Led Supplier AI releases with zero production regressions, owning end-to-end validation, sanity checks, and delivery timelines across cross-functional teams.
Reduced development effort by 60% through strategic adoption of AI-powered development tools and workflow automation, accelerating feature delivery and improving team productivity.
Created Confluence documentation to support AI adoption and conducted KT sessions to enable faster onboarding and reduce team ramp-up time.

Conducted R&D on translation/transliteration APIs; built optimized pipelines using Python multiprocessing and Azure Cognitive Services, automating multilingual workflows and reducing manual effort by ~90%.

projects.title: Deep RL for Automated Portfolio Management
projects.description: Deep reinforcement learning for optimized stock portfolio management strategies.
highlights: Implemented and benchmarked 6 deep reinforcement learning algorithms — PPO, A2C, DDPG, TD3, SAC, and a novel Average Reward TRPO — for stock portfolio management on DJIA and NIFTY 50 datasets.
Developed an Average Reward TRPO framework that outperformed all discounted-reward baseline models in cumulative return across multiple market environments.
Validated model performance through extensive back-testing and live paper trading using the Alpaca API.
